login.passwordless: No password to remember. Sign in using the one-time link in your email.

errors.not_configured: Login is not configured on this site yet. Please contact SuPrep support.
errors.invalid_input: Check your email address and verification code, then try again.
errors.invalid_email: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.
errors.invalid_code: This code could not be verified. Use the latest code from your email, or request a new sign-in email.
errors.expired_code: This code or link is invalid or has expired. Request a new email and use its latest link or code.
errors.network: We could not reach the sign-in service. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.email_restricted: We could not send the email. SuPrep’s email sender is not set up for public signups yet. Please contact SuPrep support.
errors.email_rate_limit: The sign-in email limit has been reached. Wait before trying again. If this continues, contact SuPrep support.
errors.rate_limit: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.email_delivery: The email service could not send your message. Please try again later or contact SuPrep support.
errors.account_exists: This email already has an account. Sign up does not change its password or username. Log in with the existing password, or reset it below.
errors.account_missing: No account was found for this email. Check the address or choose Sign up.
errors.signup_disabled: An account cannot be created for this address right now. If you already have an account, choose Log in; otherwise contact SuPrep support.
errors.provider_disabled: This sign-in method is not enabled. Choose another available method or contact SuPrep support.
errors.service_unavailable: The sign-in service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.callback_invalid: We could not verify this sign-in link. Open it in the same browser where you requested it, or request a new email.
errors.failed: Sign-in could not be completed. Try again, or share the error code below with SuPrep support.
errors.invalid_username: Choose a non-empty username with 1–40 characters.
errors.username_taken: This username is already taken. Choose another one.
errors.weak_password: Use a password with at least 8 characters and no more than 72 bytes.
errors.invalid_credentials: The email / username or password is incorrect.
errors.email_unconfirmed: Verify your email using the confirmation link before logging in.
errors.password_mismatch: The passwords do not match. Enter the same new password in both fields.
errors.recovery_required: Your reset session is missing or expired. Request a new reset link and open it in this browser.
errors.same_password: Choose a password different from your current one.

login.deliveryHint: Check Spam/Junk too. Your email normally contains a sign-in link; a numeric code appears only when the email template includes one.
login.usernameHint: 1–40 characters. Any language, spaces, emojis, and symbols are welcome.
login.confirmEmail: Open the verification link sent to {email}, then log in with your password.
login.passwordPrivacy: Your password is securely managed by Supabase Auth.

recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.lead: Enter your registered email address. We will send you a password-reset link.
recovery.sent: If an account exists for this email, a password-reset link will arrive shortly. Check Spam/Junk too, and open the link in this browser.
recovery.updateLead: Choose a new password for your SuPrep account.
recovery.updated: Your password has been updated. Log in with your new password.
